hypotheses.justification: If 0 ≤ T, the existing proof applies. If T < 0, Icc (0 : ℝ) T is empty, so AnnularEnvelope.timePositionVolume T—and hence its product with velocity volume—is the zero measure. By the definition of UniformIntegrable, both conclusions then hold for any functions, since the relevant eLpNorms are zero. Thus the theorem can be proved without hT by splitting on 0 ≤ T; hTmax does not exclude the negative case.
